s1.title: 1. Preface
s1.p1: Despite its remarkable growth, the cryptocurrency market continues to face fundamental structural challenges. The lack of transparency in asset backing, price manipulation by market whales, reliance on centralized order books, and the risks associated with speculative bubbles have left investors exposed to extreme and unpredictable volatility.
s1.p2: Fly Infinity Platform has been designed in response to these challenges. It is a decentralized platform with the goal of creating a transparent digital asset with real backing, built on a structure that reduces the risk of price reversal to zero.

s2.title: 2. Introduction to Fly Infinity Platform
s2.p1: Fly Infinity is a next-generation decentralized financial platform built upon two fully complementary economic components:
s2.sub1text: An intelligent and autonomous network responsible for injecting real capital into the token contract. This network continuously increases liquidity without the need to mint new tokens.
s2.sub2text: The platform's primary digital asset, whose price is calculated not based on market hype, but solely on the ratio of DAI Reserve to Total Supply.

s3.title: 3. Pricing Formula (Bonding Curve)
s3.p1: The price of the FIT token is calculated transparently and immutably within the smart contract:
s3.formula: FIT Price = DAI Reserve ÷ Total Supply
s3.f1: Immutable: The price cannot be altered by any external entity.
s3.f2: Transparent: Calculable and verifiable at any moment.
s3.f3: Continuously Rising: Each purchase increases liquidity and raises the base price.

s4.title: 4. Unique Feature: Non-Diminishing Price
s4.p1: Fly Infinity is the only project where the base token price never decreases. This is achieved through the following logic:

table.buyEffect: Real DAI enters the contract → Liquidity increases → Price increases
table.sellEffect: Tokens are burned → Supply decreases → Price increases

s4.p2: Result: Even large sell-offs do not necessarily reduce the price — in many cases, they increase it.

s5.li2: All rules are embedded in public, immutable smart contracts.
s5.li3: No entity can stop, alter, or censor transactions.

s6.title: 6. Step-Based Purchase Model
s6.p1: To prevent sudden whale entry and maintain healthy price growth, FIT purchases are structured in a step-based system:
s6.how: How It Works: Each user can purchase only once per step, up to the specified cap. After earning the required network points, the next step becomes available. The total purchase cap increases cumulatively as users progress through the steps.

s7.title: Infinity Development Network Advantage
s7.p1: Unlock Superior Purchase Power Through Network Structure
s7.p2: The Infinity Development Network introduces a revolutionary mechanism that empowers users to purchase significantly larger amounts of FIT with substantially fewer ownership shares. This is achieved through the intelligent binary tree structure of the network, where each share placed in the network generates network points that directly increase the user's purchase capacity.
s7.p3: How the Binary Tree Multiplier Works:
s7.li1: Traditional Model: Each ownership share provides a fixed purchase cap of 100 DAI. To purchase 6,000 DAI worth of FIT, a user would need 60 shares, costing an additional 6,000 DAI — total investment of 12,000 DAI.
s7.li2: Infinity Development Model: By strategically placing shares in a balanced binary tree (1 upline + 2 downline per node), the same 6,000 DAI purchase can be achieved with only 40 shares — a 33% reduction in required shares.
s7.li3: Accumulated Advantage: As the purchase amount increases, the efficiency gap widens. For larger purchases, the Infinity Development Network can reduce required shares by up to 50% or more, dramatically lowering the total capital needed to acquire FIT.
s7.p4: Mathematical Proof: In a balanced binary tree with 40 shares, the network generates 57 reward points (as verified through our reward calculation model). Each point represents unlocked purchase capacity, allowing users to achieve higher purchase caps with fewer shares. This is not a promotional claim — it is a mathematically verifiable property of the Infinity Development Network architecture.
s7.p5: Key Takeaway: The Infinity Development Network is not merely a referral system — it is a financial engineering innovation that mathematically optimizes capital efficiency. Users who understand and leverage this structure can acquire FIT with significantly lower capital outlay compared to traditional direct purchase methods.
s7.example: Example: 6,000 DAI FIT Purchase — Traditional: 60 shares, 12,000 DAI total cost | Infinity Development: 40 shares, 10,000 DAI total cost | Savings: 2,000 DAI (17% reduction)

hero.title: Our vision, architecture and economic design: the FIT token model, Network, games, AI services and the ecosystem we are building.
hero.subtitle: Our vision, architecture and economic design: the FIT token model, Network, games, AI services and the ecosystem we are building.
hero.kicker: FLY INFINITY · OFFICIAL FOUNDER WHITE PAPER

s1.title: 01 · Executive overview
s1.body: We, the founders of Fly Infinity, created this ecosystem to bring together the FIT token, Network participation, community governance, games and AI services on BNB Smart Chain. This white paper is our official presentation of the vision, architecture, economic design and products we are building. It describes the operation of the deployed contracts and the initiatives in our development roadmap. The FIT price discussed here is the value calculated by its dedicated contract from the DAI reserve and total FIT supply.

s2.title: 02 · FIT token architecture
s2.body: FIT is an ERC-20-based token whose ordinary transfer, transferFrom and approve entry points are deliberately disabled in the current contract. FIT is minted through the contract's Buy logic and redeemed through Sell logic, where the seller's FIT is burned. The Buy path can mint only to an address recognized by the Network as an owner (or be called by the Network contract); the Sell path checks the caller as a Network owner, with the Network contract also permitted. This design is incompatible with ordinary free-transfer trading.

s3.title: 03 · The on-chain price formula
s3.body: Let R be the DAI balance held by the FIT token contract, S the FIT total supply, and W = 10¹⁸ the decimal scale. The contract returns P = floor(R × W ÷ S); when supply is zero, Price() returns 1 DAI (10¹⁸ units). The initial Genesis_Liquidity call requires 10 DAI, mints 10 FIT to the token contract itself and deposits the DAI, establishing a 1 DAI reference price. Later Genesis_Liquidity deposits add reserve without minting more FIT.

s4.title: 04 · Mathematical proof: purchases and sales
s4.body: Purchase: for DAI input A, the contract retains all A in reserve, calculates fee f = floor(3A/100), and mints m = floor((A−f)×W/P) FIT. Since P×m ≤ (A−f)×W ≤ A×W and P×S ≤ R×W, we obtain (R+A)×W ≥ P×(S+m); therefore the next integer price floor cannot be below P. Sale: for x FIT, gross DAI g = floor(x×P/W), fee h = floor(6g/100), and payout q = g−h. Since q×W ≤ g×W ≤ x×P, (R−q)×W ≥ P×(S−x); the next integer price floor is therefore at least P. The proof follows the integer operations in the current source code, assuming successful execution and a standard 18-decimal DAI token.

s5.title: 05 · A worked example
s5.body: Illustration using exact whole-token amounts, before any additional Network reserve deposits: Genesis starts at 10 DAI / 10 FIT = 1.0000 DAI per FIT. A 100 DAI purchase adds 100 DAI to reserve and mints 97 FIT after the 3% purchase fee: 110 DAI / 107 FIT ≈ 1.0280. Selling 50 FIT at that contract price burns all 50 FIT and pays 94% of the calculated gross value: reserve ≈ 61.6822 DAI, supply 57 FIT, price ≈ 1.0821. Actual on-chain results use integer units and rounding.

s6.title: 06 · Why FIT is not listed on external exchanges
s6.body: We have deliberately chosen a contract-native model for FIT. Conventional exchanges and independent liquidity pools rely on assets moving between wallets, custody accounts and pools. FIT instead uses dedicated Buy and Sell functions, while standard transfer and approval routes are restricted by design. Accordingly, FIT is designed to operate within its own contract framework rather than external exchange order books or third-party liquidity pools. Our policy is clear: we do not plan to seek or pursue FIT listings on external exchanges. Its intended purchase, redemption and contract price reference remain within the dedicated FIT contract.

s7.title: 07 · Network reserve flows and governance
s7.body: The Network contract processes participation and reward logic. In Reward_Internal(), after its reward transfers and any eligible caller payment, the remaining DAI balance is transferred to the FIT token contract. For designated support addresses, Check_Support() routes certain reward transfers directly to the FIT contract. These deposits increase R without minting FIT at that moment. The DAO source defines proposal and networker-voting processes for changing Network and Gift contract addresses; it should not be read as proof that every project decision is governed by token-holder voting.

s8.title: 08 · Games and AI services
s8.body: Fly Infinity Games currently presents Chess Arena, Backgammon, Hokm, Ludo and Snakes & Ladders. The published game hub describes entry as free, with no entry fee, token transfer or financial rewards; access requires a wallet holding at least 1 FIT and a free signature. Fly Infinity AI provides a wallet-gated assistant workspace with ecosystem, FIT, contract and transaction-oriented tools. Its published access tiers are Explorer (verified Network owner), Advanced (owner plus at least 1 FIT) and Elite (owner plus at least 10 FIT). AI output can be wrong and should be independently verified.

s9.title: 09 · Planned ecosystem initiatives
s9.body: The public Upcoming Projects page describes a proposed Fly Infinity DEX, Marketplace, Lottery and Fly Infinity Pay, with launch targets expressed as FIT-holder milestones. These are plans, not statements that the products are already live. Each initiative remains subject to technical feasibility, funding, legal requirements, security review and a separate public release announcement. In particular, any lottery concept would require jurisdiction-specific legal review and eligibility rules.

s10.title: Security, transparency and participant information
s10.body: Transparency and responsible development guide our work. We publish the contract and frontend source in our public GitHub repository, and on-chain state can be independently inspected. Fly Infinity operates through smart contracts, BNB Smart Chain, DAI and connected wallet infrastructure; understanding these components, protecting wallet access and observing applicable requirements are part of informed participation. The reserve-to-supply formula describes the contract's accounting price and its defined purchase and redemption processes. This white paper is our official project overview of the design and development direction.

s11.title: 11 · Why we use GitHub Pages and a public GitHub address
s11.body: We chose GitHub Pages and the project’s public GitHub address as a deliberate infrastructure decision. The web application is published from the same public repository where its source code, versions and development history can be inspected. Participants, developers and independent reviewers can compare the published frontend with the source, follow changes over time and review the public record of updates. A personal server or private domain can be useful, but it is not a prerequisite for a credible, maintainable or transparent application. GitHub Pages lets us use an established hosting and HTTPS delivery platform while keeping the application’s source and change history publicly accessible, rather than depending on an opaque private hosting environment. Hosting on GitHub does not transfer ownership of Fly Infinity, its repository or product decisions to GitHub; these remain with the project maintainers. The public repository also enables community review, issue reporting and contributions through standard Git workflows. The frontend is only one layer of the ecosystem: blockchain operations are governed by the published smart contracts on BNB Smart Chain, while specific dynamic services may run on their respective infrastructure. Open source and public deployment improve inspectability and accountability, but they are not a security audit and do not guarantee software is free of vulnerabilities. We encourage users and independent reviewers to examine the source, contract addresses, on-chain activity and release history directly.

purchaseLimits.title: 06A · Staged purchase limits and balanced network growth
purchaseLimits.body: We designed FIT purchase limits to align an individual wallet’s purchase capacity with balanced activity across the Network. The contract reads the cumulative points on the left and right branches and uses the smaller side as the qualification measure. Each milestone unlocks an additional amount of cumulative DAI purchase capacity. This staged structure is intended to reduce excessive concentration of purchases in a single wallet, encourage balanced network development and support a more orderly flow of DAI into the FIT reserve as purchases take place. The limit is cumulative per wallet, not a separate allowance for every transaction. It is a concentration-management mechanism, not a guarantee that large holdings cannot be distributed across multiple wallets. For direct owner purchases, the contract records the DAI amount against the wallet’s cumulative limit.
